title: Observability and Analysis
description: RJSF form schema for creating a Observability and Analysis credential. Captures the user-input fields of the canonical Credential construct; the `secret` object is the type-specific shape persisted under the canonical free-form `secret` map. Field shape, types, enums, and required list MUST stay a subset of meshery/schemas/constructs/v1beta1/credential/api.yml#/components/schemas/Credential; the Go validator at validation/forms_test.go enforces that.
